Land Aquisition - Thissawawawaththa,Nuwaragampalatha Central D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Sec 33
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of Land Acquisition Notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It deals specifically with the acquisition of land parcels, deposit of nominal compensation, and detailed land descriptions including location, extent, and lot numbers. This fits precisely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
